title: PCB Prestige

services.name: Dolphin Tours
services.desc: Enjoy a 3‑hour private dolphin and Shell Island snorkeling tour in Panama City Beach with your own licensed local captain. Watch wild dolphins, explore clear, shallow water, and relax on a clean, comfortable boat that’s perfect for families and small groups. Our private dolphin tours in Panama City Beach are 3‑hour charters for up to 6 guests. We explore St. Andrews Bay and the waters around Shell Island, looking for wild dolphins, stopping at sandbars, and giving you time to swim and snorkel in calm, shallow water. This is a private experience, so it’s just your group and the captain on board. You can move at your own pace, ask questions, and choose how you want to spend your time-more

services.name: Private boat charter
services.desc: Yes, tipping is customary on captained boat tours, whether it’s a dolphin cruise, a fishing charter, or a sunset sail. The practical baseline is a moderate percentage of the trip cost, or a flat amount for short outings where percentages get fussy. Bring cash when you can, and confirm the operator’s gratuity policy before you assume it’s built into your bill. Tipping for captained boat tours typically ranges from 15% to 20%, with higher tips for exceptional service or memorable wildlife encounters. services.name: Sunset Cruises
services.desc: Enjoy a private sunset cruise in Panama City Beach with your own licensed local captain. Relax on a clean, comfortable boat as you watch the sky change colors, look for dolphins, and take in the best views of St. Andrews Bay and Shell Island. Glide across calm evening water while the sun sets over Panama City Beach. It’s the perfect time for photos, quiet moments, and soaking in the Gulf Coast skyline. Sunset is a great time to spot dolphins and other marine life. We watch respectfully from a safe distance so you can enjoy natural behavior without disturbing the animals.
